rule: Parser operator aliases preserve denotation
notes: Alias spelling changes no semantic operator.

rule: NOOP and internal END wrappers erase without changing payload
notes: Only structural wrappers are removed.

rule: Capture-avoiding LET beta reduction
notes: Lexical binder identity, not spelling, controls substitution.

rule: Implication eliminates to disjunction with a negated antecedent
notes: The antecedent is the unique implicit-negative branch.

rule: IFF eliminates to the conjunction of both implications
notes: Both implicit-negative branches are retained.

rule: Boolean ITE eliminates to guarded then and else branches
notes: The else branch receives the condition negation.

rule: Boolean constant negation and double negation
baseline_name: boolean constant negation and double negation
notes: Applies only to authorized Boolean formulas.

rule: De Morgan dualizes conjunction and disjunction
notes: The proof covers each operand and Java generalizes over the variadic container.

rule: Atomic formula negation uses exact semantic duals
notes: Comparison proofs use exact integer order and subset semantics.

rule: Temporal negation uses all eight unary and binary duals
notes: Lean uses direct trace semantics for release and triggered, not aliases.

rule: Negated quantifiers switch quantifier kind and matrix polarity
notes: ONE and LONE consume negation into explicit internal complements.

rule: NO quantification expands to universal quantification of a negated body
notes: No second matrix negation is introduced.

rule: Quantification over an empty admissible domain folds by quantifier truth
notes: The admissible binding set, not spelling alone, must be empty.

rule: Carrier-independent false or true quantified bodies fold exactly
notes: Carrier-dependent constant cases remain explicit.

rule: Existential quantification moves across conjunction without capture
notes: The outside branch is independent of the bound variable.

rule: Universal quantification moves across disjunction without capture
notes: The outside branch is independent of the bound variable.

rule: Licensed Boolean relational integer and dependent-chain operators flatten associatively
notes: JOIN and ARROW retain sequence order and require dependent boundary evidence.

rule: Licensed Boolean relational integer comparison and disjoint operators commute
notes: Sequence operators are excluded.

rule: Only SET or otherwise licensed ACI operators eliminate duplicate operands
notes: Integer BAG and relational SEQUENCE multiplicities are retained.

rule: Boolean identities and annihilators simplify exact Boolean containers
notes: Generic Bool-looking metadata is not authority.

rule: A proposition and its certified complement collapse the Boolean container
notes: Operand equality must be certified in the same quotient.

rule: Subset membership against none or univ folds only under its exact guards
notes: The false none rule requires a nonempty left relation.

rule: Relational union eliminates none and absorbs univ
notes: Only authenticated same-arity constants participate.

rule: Relational intersection absorbs none and eliminates univ
notes: Only authenticated same-arity constants participate.

rule: Alpha renaming preserves the scoped binder action
notes: Readable names are diagnostics only; scope identity controls slots.

rule: Complex quantified domains become exact local implication conjunction or negated-existence guards
notes: Primitive carrier facts already encoded in QuantiVar are not duplicated.

rule: A single quantified membership formula reduces according to multiplicity polarity and exact set semantics
notes: EXACTLY multiplicity is explicitly outside this eliminator.

rule: Converse is involutive and distributes over union intersection and difference
notes: Exact binary relation evidence is required.

rule: Cartesian products factor unions by fixed coordinates or complete grids
notes: Partial and diagonal grids are barriers.

rule: Intersections of equal-arity products factor coordinatewise
notes: Every source contributes exactly one operand to every coordinate.

rule: Boolean and relational lattices apply absorption and factored distributivity contextually
notes: Only the matched submultiset is replaced.

rule: Difference distributes or factors against union and intersection with a common operand
notes: Typed slot invocations remain attached to their operand.

rule: JOIN factors union on either side and within an ordered chain
notes: JOIN order and exact boundary types are preserved.

rule: SOME and NO distribute over finite relational union
notes: The Boolean result uses the matching ACI polarity.

rule: Left-nested difference accumulates removed operands by union
notes: Right nesting is explicitly not reassociated by this rule.

rule: Right-nested difference expands into retained difference plus restored intersection
notes: Exact relation occurrence evidence is required.

rule: Intersection extracts and combines relational differences
notes: Every removed operand is retained in the result.

rule: Product difference factors only one differing coordinate
notes: Multiple-coordinate differences remain explicit.

rule: Domain and range restrictions distribute through their relation and restrictor lattices
notes: Diagonal coordinate combinations do not factor.

rule: Restriction and difference factor only in their sound coordinate laws
notes: Multi-coordinate difference is an explicit barrier.

rule: Nested same-side restrictions intersect and opposite sides commute
notes: Coordinate roles remain explicit.

rule: Converse reverses JOIN order and transposes every operand
notes: Preserving source order is a proved counterexample.

rule: Converse commutes with transitive and reflexive-transitive closure
notes: Closure kind is preserved.

rule: Converse swaps domain and range restriction
notes: The unswapped coordinate is not admitted.

rule: Restriction by a full endpoint is identity and an empty coordinate is zero
notes: Full-carrier authority must be parser certified.

rule: Endpoint and internal JOIN restrictions move only to their proved coordinates
notes: Exact arity determines whether a coordinate survives composition.

rule: Reflexive subset equality and explicit negations fold under certified operand identity
notes: Surface spelling alone cannot establish identity.

rule: Structural subset closes union injection intersection difference and restriction projection
notes: Every recursive step retains equal arity and authority.

rule: Subset over union-left and intersection-right expands conjunctively with exact negated duals
notes: Unsound opposite disjunctions remain explicit.

rule: Subset of typed none becomes NO and its negation becomes SOME
notes: Both operands require the same parser-certified relation arity.

rule: A structurally contained union or intersection operand is absorbed
notes: Union removes the smaller operand and intersection removes the larger.

rule: A difference intersects every subrelation of its removed side to none
notes: The subrelation proof is structural and typed.

rule: Difference and its retained partition recombine to the original relation
notes: Unrelated variadic siblings are retained.

rule: Difference normalizes superrelation intersection and restored-difference partitions
notes: The result type must match the source occurrence.

rule: Emptiness and nonemptiness of difference are exact subset duals
notes: Restrictions are rebuilt on both coordinates before comparison.

rule: Unary domain and range restrictions coincide and orient to DOMAIN
notes: Higher arity preserves distinct coordinate roles.

rule: Converse and closure of exact empty binary relations normalize to typed empty or iden
notes: The result retains exact binary arity.

rule: Complete abstract-signature unions recover their certified carrier
notes: Every direct abstract extension branch must be present.

rule: Full signature carriers absorb only parser-certified subrelations
notes: A common type label is insufficient.

rule: Identity JOIN transpose and closure fixed points normalize under exact identity authority
notes: Forged iden spellings are excluded.

rule: ARROW and JOIN with an exact empty operand produce an arity-preserving empty relation
notes: Nullary and wrong-arity empties are outside the rule.
